statements.statement: Two electrons placed near each other will attract each other.
statements.explanation: Like charges repel. Since both electrons carry a negative charge, they push each other away. Only opposite charges (positive and negative) attract.
Of the three main subatomic particles, only protons (positive) and electrons (negative) carry charge. Neutrons are electrically neutral, which is where their name comes from.

statements.statement: The push and pull between positive and negative charges is what makes electrons move.
statements.explanation: The attractive force between opposite charges and the repulsive force between like charges are what drive electron movement, which is the foundation of electricity.
